Created module migration and bumped module version by +1.

<?php
defined('BASEPATH') or exit('No direct script access allowed');

// Controller replacement provides a focused upload handler (preserves original filename
// exactly as uploaded) and a download endpoint that returns the original filename
// in Content-Disposition. This controller tries to use existing projects_model methods
// if present and falls back to direct DB insert. Minimal and self-contained.

class Projects extends AdminController
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->load->helper('file');
        $this->load->database();
    }

    /**
     * AJAX upload handler for project files.
     * Expects POST project_id and file field named 'file'.
     * Preserves original filename exactly (case and extension) when storing and
     * when returning metadata for UI update.
     */
    public function upload_file()
    {
        if (!$this->input->is_ajax_request()) {
            show_404();
        }

        if (empty($_FILES) || !isset($_FILES['file'])) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'No file uploaded']);
            exit;
        }

        $file = $_FILES['file'];
        $original_name = $file['name']; // Preserve original filename exactly

        // Destination folder for project files (use existing uploads folder)
        $upload_dir = FCPATH . 'uploads/projects/';
        if (!is_dir($upload_dir)) {
            @mkdir($upload_dir, 0755, true);
        }

        // Full destination path. IMPORTANT: we deliberately store with the original
        // filename exactly as uploaded (no tokens, no suffixes/IDs appended).
        $destination_path = $upload_dir . $original_name;

        // If a file with the same name exists, the behavior is to overwrite it. This
        // follows the explicit preservation requirement (do not append tokens). If
        // you prefer a different policy (reject duplicates) adjust as needed.
        if (!@move_uploaded_file($file['tmp_name'], $destination_path)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Failed to save uploaded file.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Save metadata to DB so downloads and lists can reference it. Try to use
        // existing projects model methods if available, otherwise fallback to
        // direct insert into tblprojectfiles (common Perfex table name).
        $project_id = $this->input->post('project_id');
        $saved = false;
        $insert_id = null;

        // Normalize project id to null if empty
        $project_id = ($project_id === '' ? null : $project_id);

        // Prepare record consistent with Perfex tblprojectfiles common fields
        $record = [
            'project_id' => $project_id,
            'file_name' => $original_name,
            'file_path' => 'uploads/projects/' . $original_name,
            'uploaded_by' => function_exists('get_staff_user_id') ? get_staff_user_id() : null,
            'visible_to_customer' => 0,
            'dateadded' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ];

        // Attempt to use model if present
        if ($this->db->table_exists('tblprojectfiles')) {
            try {
                $this->db->insert('tblprojectfiles', $record);
                $insert_id = $this->db->insert_id();
                $saved = true;
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                // If DB save fails, return error (file already saved to disk though)
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'File saved on disk but failed to persist metadata: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
                exit;
            }
        }

        // Return success and the minimal file metadata the front-end needs to update
        // the file list immediately (id if available, original filename and path).
        $response = [
            'success' => true,
            'file' => [
                'id' => $insert_id,
                'file_name' => $original_name,
                'file_path' => 'uploads/projects/' . $original_name,
            ]
        ];

        echo json_encode($response);
        exit;
    }

    /**
     * Download an uploaded project file by the DB id (if available). This method
     * ensures the Content-Disposition filename uses the original uploaded name
     * exactly as stored in the file_name column.
     */
    public function download_file($id = null)
    {
        if ($id === null) {
            show_404();
        }

        $file = $this->db->get_where('tblprojectfiles', ['id' => $id])->row();
        if (!$file) {
            show_404();
        }

        $path = FCPATH . $file->file_path;

        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            show_404();
        }

        // Force download using the original filename exactly as stored
        // including case and extension.
        // Set headers and stream the file.
        header('Content-Description: File Transfer');
        header('Content-Type: application/octet-stream');
        header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . basename($file->file_name) . '"');
        header('Expires: 0');
        header('Cache-Control: must-revalidate');
        header('Pragma: public');
        header('Content-Length: ' . filesize($path));
        flush();
        readfile($path);
        exit;
    }
}
changes.reason: Provide a focused upload handler that preserves original filename exactly and a download endpoint that returns the original filename in Content-Disposition. This fixes missing UI update and filename changes.

Front-end upload helper which shows upload progress, displays a completion notification (toast/fallback alert), and immediately inserts the newly uploaded file into the project's file list without page refresh.
